summary: Lane B (N11 / G53 / G54) only; no anchors, no type work — the ep 12 anchor and its divergence annotation from wave 7 stand untouched. The wave-7 flag is CONFIRMED and it is a two-row defect, not one: our stored ep 11 = 2018-03-31 and ep 12 = 2018-04-01 are both wrong. syobocal's per-airing records for TID 4796 give the production station MBS a clean, unbroken weekly run of Counts 1-12 (2018-01-13 02:40 … 2018-03-31 02:40, every one a Saturday post-midnight, no 再 flag on any row, no preemption week), so ep 11 = 2018-03-24 and ep 12 = 2018-03-31; en-WP's episode table, MAL's episode list and ja-WP's 放送局 table (毎日放送 2018年1月13日 - 3月31日, 土曜 2:25-2:55) all agree. The stored values are AFL's: animefillerlist's live page prints 11 = 2018-03-31 and 12 = 2018-04-01 — it drops 03-24 entirely, slides the MBS finale date onto row 11, and finishes on 2018-04-01, which is BS-TBS's Sunday 00:30 slot (syobocal BS-TBS Count 12 = 2018-04-01 00:30; ja-WP BS-TBS 1月14日 - 4月1日). Our stored ep 10 = 2018-03-17 is the MBS calendar date (BS-TBS would be 03-18, AT-X 03-21, the EPG evening label 03-16), so rows 1-10 already sit in the MBS post-midnight CALENDAR regime and the two repairs put the whole 12-row run in that one regime. No true out-of-order broadcast exists here — nothing to ack under G54.

repairs.why: G53. Ep 11 「ママを…いじめるな」 / 'Don't Bully Mom' aired on MBS Sat 2018-03-24 02:25-02:55 (the Animeism B2 slot, listed by EPGs as Fri 3/23 late-night). syobocal TID 4796, MBS毎日放送, Count=11, StTime 2018-03-24 02:25:00, Flag=0 — no 再 bit, and it is the only MBS airing carrying Count 11. en-WP's episode table: ep 11 = March 24, 2018; MAL's episode list: ep 11 = Mar 24, 2018. The stored 2018-03-31 is the FINALE's MBS date: AFL's live page omits 2018-03-24 altogether and shifts every later row by one airing, which is where our value came from (join by title and date, never index — R20). Row identity is independently fixed by the official site's story/11.html (staff 脚本 小柳啓伍 / 絵コンテ 斗万旦一 / 総作画監督 田澤潮 = ja-WP's 11th Bite, and the Ratel-vs-Pangolin decisive-battle synopsis) — so the title is right and only the date moves. Repair must land at the manual tier (P8): AFL will otherwise re-seed 2018-03-31.

G53. The finale 「今までありがとな」 / 'Thanks for Everything' aired on MBS Sat 2018-03-31 02:40-03:10 (start pushed 15 min by the preceding programme; EPG-labelled Fri 3/30 late-night). syobocal TID 4796, MBS毎日放送, Count=12, StTime 2018-03-31 02:40:00, Flag=4 (最終回), no 再 bit. ja-WP's 放送局 table gives 毎日放送（製作局）2018年1月13日 - 3月31日; en-WP's table ends March 31, 2018; MAL: Mar 31, 2018. The stored 2018-04-01 is a Sunday and is BS-TBS's date for the same episode (syobocal BS-TBS Count=12, 2018-04-01 00:30; ja-WP BS-TBS 1月14日 - 4月1日) — i.e. a different station's regime on one row of an otherwise MBS-dated run; AFL prints it. Since our ep 10 is stored as 2018-03-17 (MBS calendar, not BS-TBS's 03-18), the repair makes the run one regime rather than imposing a new one. Manual tier (P8).

structure.notes:
SLOT REGIME. Killing Bites ran on MBS (製作局) Saturdays 02:25-02:55 — a POST-MIDNIGHT slot, so three different 'dates' exist for every episode: (a) the calendar date of the airing (Saturday) — syobocal StTime, en-WP, MAL, AFL rows 1-10; (b) the broadcaster's/EPG evening label (Friday, one day earlier) — WEBザテレビジョン prints '2018年3月30日 MBS' for #12 and heads the programme '毎週金曜夜2:25-2:55'; (c) BS-TBS's own slot, Sunday 00:30, one day AFTER the MBS calendar date. OUR CATALOG STORES THE CALENDAR DATE (a): stored ep 10 = 2018-03-17 is MBS's Saturday calendar date (evening label would be 03-16, BS-TBS 03-18, AT-X 03-21). Both repairs keep regime (a) for the whole run; rows 11 and 12 are the only two rows not already in it (row 12 sits in regime (c), row 11 holds row 12's regime-(a) date).

NO GAP WEEK, NO REORDER. syobocal's MBS rows run Count 1..12 on twelve consecutive Saturdays (01-13, 01-20, 01-27, 02-03, 02-10, 02-17, 02-24, 03-03, 03-10, 03-17, 03-24, 03-31); Count 1 started 02:40 and Counts 6/7/10 at 02:35 and Count 12 at 02:40 (sports/news overrun pushing the block, not a date move). Every stored/proposed date is a Saturday — the slot sweep is clean for all 12 rows and nothing needs a G54 ack.

AFL IS THE SEEDER AND IT IS DEFECTIVE HERE. AFL's live table (slug killing-bites) prints exactly our stored dates and our stored English title FORMS ('Damn... Damn Damn Damn Damn!!', 'I Will Never Change My Mind!', 'I Might Fall For You' — en-WP and MAL use 'Shit...Shit shit shit shit!!', 'I Will Never Change My Mind About That', 'Shit, I Might Fall For You'), so the whole run was seeded from AFL. AFL's rows 1-10 are the correct MBS calendar dates; only its last two rows are wrong (03-24 dropped, 03-31 slid onto row 11, BS-TBS's 04-01 appended as row 12). This is a DATE defect, not a numbering defect: AFL's row COUNT is 12, its titles join 1:1 with ja-WP/en-WP/MAL, and no N11 shift exists — the two rows keep their titles and only their dates move.

LIMIT OF WHAT I COULD VERIFY DIRECTLY. My context file printed stored dates only for the target rows 10-12 (10 = 2018-03-17, 11 = 2018-03-31, 12 = 2018-04-01). Rows 1-9's stored dates were not visible to me, so the '(stored ok)' cells above are an inference from AFL-as-seeder (its rows 1-10 = the MBS calendar dates, and its row 10 is byte-identical to our stored row 10) rather than a read of the DB. The table gives the apply layer the reference values to diff rows 1-9 against; if any of them differs from the column, it is a separate defect this verdict did not see.

ENGLISH TITLES (not a repair, noted only). Our stored English titles are AFL's censored/short forms; en-WP and MAL carry the uncensored Amazon Video forms. This is a house-style difference across the whole catalog, not an identity error, and is out of this ask — no title repair is proposed.

flags_for_sean: NO G54 ACK NEEDED. There is no true broadcast deviation on this series: MBS aired Counts 1-12 on twelve consecutive Saturdays with no preemption, no rerun (no 再 flag on any of the 12 MBS rows) and no out-of-order airing. Both stored anomalies are pure data defects from AFL.

DERIVATION-TIER RE-SEED RISK (P8). AFL's live page still prints 11 = 2018-03-31 and 12 = 2018-04-01. If these two rows' dates are held at any AFL-derived tier the repair will be overwritten on the next refresh — they must land manual. Worth a note that AFL's killing-bites table is a witness for titles but NOT for the last two air dates.

MIXED-STATION LINEAGE IS THE DEFECT SHAPE (the one-piece-log lesson, seen again). AFL's finale date here is another broadcaster's (BS-TBS Sun 00:30, one day after MBS). The generic check that catches it is a day-of-week sweep against the production station's slot: 2018-04-01 is a Sunday in a run of Saturdays, and both wrong rows still ASCENDED, so the order gate never saw them. Killing Bites may not be the only AFL-seeded MBS/Animeism series with a BS-TBS date on its finale row.

ROWS 1-9 NOT DIFFED AGAINST THE DB (scope limit, not a finding). The context file exposes stored dates only for rows 10-12; the identity table in structure.notes carries the sourced reference date for every row 1-12 so the apply layer can complete the 1:1 title+date join. Row 10 (the join check named in the ask) passes exactly: stored 2018-03-17 = syobocal MBS Count 10 = en-WP = MAL = AFL.
